description: Partner accounts only. Get a single-use link to upload one image (JPG or PNG, up to 9 MB), valid for 10 minutes. Send the file to it with HTTP PUT; the response says where the image is stored. Channel images, artist images and a release cover replace the current one. A channel_news upload returns a URL to pass to save_channel_post.

filename.description: The file's name, ending in .jpg, .jpeg or .png.

name: create_image_upload

command.description: A curl command that uploads the file; replace <file> with its path.

error.description: Present when the call did not succeed.

reason.description: not_a_partner when the signed-in account has no partner account.

title: Get an image upload link
